title: Seafood Marinara Pasta
rawIngredients: 6 oz / 180g dried spaghetti pasta (or other long pasta of choice)
2 cups tomato passata / tomato puree (or 600g canned crushed tomato + 1/2 cup water)
Salt and black pepper to taste
method: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Cook pasta according to packet directions, reducing time by 1 minute. Reserve 1 mug of pasta cooking water, then drain pasta.
Sort the seafood mix by cooking time: fish and large prawns first, small prawns second, calamari last.

Heat 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over high heat. Sear fish and large prawns for 30 seconds, add small prawns for 30 seconds, then add calamari for 1 minute. Transfer all seafood immediately to a bowl.
Reduce heat to medium-high. Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, minced garlic, and chopped onion. Cook for 3 minutes until translucent.
Pour in the white wine, deglaze the skillet by scraping up brown bits, and simmer for 1 minute until the raw alcohol aroma dissipates.
Stir in tomato passata, sugar, salt, and pepper. Simmer over medium-high heat for 2 minutes, then adjust seasoning to taste.
Add the drained pasta, seared seafood, and approximately 1/2 cup of reserved pasta water into the sauce. Toss continuously for 1 to 2 minutes until the sauce thickens and emulsifies around the pasta.
Remove from heat, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately.
